scientific_integrity: Analytic proof for all parameters, separately accompanied by finite numerical checks. No independent audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: First responsive polynomial band only; measures are O(d)-invariant with finite positive 2q radial moment and no atom at zero. Higher-band spectra and anisotropic measures are not treated. Originality has historical-priority risk.
title: Universal first-visible checkerboard concentration spectrum for rotationally invariant polynomial bands
